verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a Python library, and its docs show agents and teams run programmatically with no UI: the agent.run(task=...) call, exporting Studio teams to run in Python code, and running teams in a Docker container. These are the building blocks of headless automation. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents CI usage, non-interactive configuration, or exit and failure handling for automated pipelines. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, a documented headless CLI entrypoint, non-interactive run guidance (e.g., replacing UserProxyAgent), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
